feeds.title: Lights Camera Crohns Blog
feeds.description: Natalie was diagnosed with Crohn's disease in 2005. Her mission in life is to be an advocate for those battling inflammatory bowel disease and to show that a chronic illness doesn't have to dull your sparkle. After several hospitalizations, countless medications and flare ups she underwent her first surgery in 2015. The blog covers everything from overcoming struggles to celebrating small victory.

feeds.title: ImproveCareNow
feeds.description: ImproveCareNow is a community restoring the wellbeing of all kids with Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis(Inflammatory Bowel Disease or IBD) by building a sustainable collaborative chronic care network.

feeds.title: Crohnically Blonde Blog
feeds.description: I'm Michelle! The voice behind Crohnically Blonde. At 25 years old. A huge part of my life is my battle with Crohn's Disease and related issues that I have had due to Crohn's. This blog is a way for me to document these things in an unfiltered and often humorous ways.

feeds.title: Own Your Crohn's Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Tina, and my struggle with Crohn's disease began 13 years ago when I was 22. My purpose in setting up this blog is for us all to realize that we can lead full & happy lives while living within the constraints of diseases & disabilities. I write about my story, IBD-specific issues, the psychosocial aspects of being young & chronically ill, in addition to interviewing others from diverse backgrounds who live full lives & celebrate every single moment of life in spite of their illnesses. I welcome you all to 'Own your Crohn's.'

feeds.title: Girl in Healing Eat. Nourish. Heal.
feeds.description: I'm Alexa! I'm a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner with Crohn's disease. I help people use nutrition to overcome digestive challenges. You'll find lots of delicious gluten free, paleo-friendly recipes here! The mission of Girl in Healing is encourage those living with IBD or other autoimmune conditions to use real food to achieve healing while providing support for them.

feeds.title: Half-Crazed Runner
feeds.description: A blog about running, health, exercise and nutrition. The author was diagnosed with Crohn's Disease. Read her journey with Crohn's disease.

feeds.title: Gutsandgrowth
feeds.description: I am a pediatric gastroenterologist at GI Care for Kids in Atlanta, Georgia. The goal of my blog is to share some of my reading in my field more broadly. In addition, I wanted to provide my voice to a wide range of topics that often have inaccurate or incomplete information.

feeds.title: Jake Borrett's Writing Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jake Borrett. I was diagnosed with Crohn's Disease at the age of thirteen and Dyspraxia at eighteen. This blog is about to share poems and stories, and articles on Crohn's Disease, Colitis, and Dyspraxia. It is writing which has given me an outlet to express my deepest fears, desires, and emotions.

feeds.title: Crohnie Mommy
feeds.description: My name is Suzy, but everyone who knows me, call me Suz. I'm a strong woman, wife to an amazing husband, Ryan, and mother to three beautiful kiddos, Lucille - 9, Alice - 7, and Guy is 5. I'm an avid runner, foodie, travel enthusiast, book nerd, lover of life and one more thing...I have Crohn's disease. I started this blog as a way to cope with my condition, and to hopefully offer some support and inspiration to others who suffer from IBD.

feeds.title: Crohn's Leaving The Seat Down
feeds.description: Hi. My name is Vern and I'm a Crohnie. This blog is about my Crohn's disease, The Inflammatory Bowel Disease. I have been living with Crohn's since 1988 after 20 years of rarely even catching a cold.

feeds.title: It Could Be Worse
feeds.description: A blog about Crohn's Disease, Migraines, Infertility, VA Healthcare, and everyday life. It Could Be Worse. A Kentuckian and Navy Veteran diagnosed with IBD - Crohn's Disease.

feeds.title: Young Crohn's Blog
feeds.description: My name is Louise and I have Crohn's disease. I started writing when I first got out of the hospital, fresh from my very first big flare up. Since then, I've been sharing my journey and exploring all the ups and downs that come along with IBD. Humour is a large part of how I function and survive through the crap, pun intended.

feeds.title: Dr. Vikram Chauhan's Blog - Ulcerative Colitis
feeds.description: Planet Ayurveda is an Indian based ayurvedic company. The company is involved in manufacturing of herbal supplements and exporting all over the world. This blog gives information about the symptoms and ayurvedic treatment of Ulcerative Colitis.

feeds.title: Ali On The Run - Crohn's disease
feeds.description: I'm Ali. I'm a writer and editor in New York City. I started Ali On The Run in October 2010 in an effort to make friends and find like-minded people in my Manhattan hometown. Ali On The Run was intended to be a running-focused blog. I have Crohn's disease. I was diagnosed when I was 7 years old.

feeds.title: The Bright Side of Crohn's
feeds.description: Staying positive, and kicking some Crohn's Disease butt. I am an IT professional, a mom, and a business owner living in Canada. I was diagnosed with Crohn's Disease in August 2008 and I feel the compulsion to blog about it. Hopefully I can be helpful to others.

feeds.title: Crohn's, Fitness, Food, and My Rocky Road To Health
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Stephanie Gish. Crohn's Fitness Food is my journey with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). I share my story, experiences, and trials with food and fitness in managing Crohn's. If you're going through your own IBD journey or are a family member supporting someone with this disease, I hope you find hope & inspiration through this blog.

feeds.title: iHaveUC
feeds.description: Ulcerative Colitis information about diet, medications, and getting back to a normal life when colitis flares happen. I started iHaveUC.com back in January of 2010 with the hopes of connecting with other UC'ers.

feeds.title: Sweetened By Nature Fighting Crohn's Disease with Nutrition
feeds.description: My name is Jamie. I have suffered from gastrointestinal problems for as long as I can remember and was officially diagnosed with Crohn's disease and gastroparesis in January of 2016. On this blog, I share my journey with Crohn's disease and passion for healthy cooking. I hope to empower others that they too can take control of their lives, feel well, and improve their health.

feeds.title: Jacob's Healing Rooms
feeds.description: My journey living with Crohn's Disease and an Ostomy. I am raising money for The Hospital for Sick Children to update the outpatient treatment rooms so that children can have a comforting and uplifting environment that promotes healing.

feeds.title: Crohn's Zone
feeds.description: Crohn's blog providing up to the minute on new developments, treatments, and research related to Crohn's disease.

feeds.title: life according to crohn's
feeds.description: I'm Hanna, 26 years young (ha!) just returned to start life all over again in New Zealand after an amazing, tough, challenging but life-changing year living & working in Austin TX (USA). I have Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). I like to keep it real & down to earth about life with a bowel disease.

feeds.title: HATTIE, ETC. - NEW MAMA | CROHN'S | WEDDING PLANNING
feeds.description: This blog is quite an IBD-based blog. But I hope to share more with you all, because there's more to me than the poos and the pain. Harriet' s Got Crohn's has now developed into Hattie, etc. Crohn's actively took up my whole first part of my twenties

feeds.title: Livin' the Crohn's Life
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Becky, a fun-loving 14 year old living near Chicago, IL. I've created this blog as a platform for me to educate and inspire other kids and teens with IBD. Through 'Livin' the Crohn's Life', I hope to spread IBD awareness and help others just like me overcome the obstacles of Crohn's disease with humor, optimism, and confidence.

feeds.title: Living My Life With Crohns
feeds.description: This blog is about the life of the author living with his Crohn's disease.

feeds.title: My Pumpkin's Journey with Crohn's Disease
feeds.description: My 16 year old daughter's path of being a teenager with Crohn's disease and hypermobility syndrome from her mother's perspective. Crohn's disease is a chronic inflammatory disorder of the gastrointestinal system, and this blog may not always be pretty. We'll probably talk about poop, pain, disgusting tests and disturbing treatments, so don't read if you're squeamish.

feeds.title: Crohn's Star
feeds.description: Exploitation Nation: Exposing corporate propaganda and suppression.

feeds.title: All about IBD
feeds.description: This blog is about how Crohn's Disease affects my everyday life.

feeds.title: Sicker Than Your Average- A blog about chronic illness stuff & things
feeds.description: I'm Sam, and I have Crohn's Disease. This blog is mainly about the Crohn's Disease part. I am here, writing this blog, because I am a writer by trade who also happens to have Crohn's Disease.

feeds.title: Crohnological Order
feeds.description: My name is Kathleen and I have been Crohn's Disease amongst several other chronic illnesses. My blog is here to entertain, educate and raise awareness by means of my disease related ramblings. Come join me on my journey of intestinal disharmony.

feeds.title: My crohns
feeds.description: My name is Nathan Portlock and I live in UK. I am making this blog for awareness of Crohns disease and also a guide, information or a place where other 'crohnies' can relate too. Please bare with me as this will take me awhile to get used to. Please share this to your delight.

feeds.title: Outrunning Crohn's Disease
feeds.description: My name is Evan Wood, and I am running to fight against Crohn's disease, a condition that I have suffered from since the age of 13. This will be my fifth time fundraising for Team IBDKids and running the NYC Marathon. My mission is to inspire millions of people with Crohn's or another limiting condition that they too can achieve greatness.

feeds.title: gut-wrenching truth about crohns Living with Crohn's!
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Jacquie. I am 30 years old. I have Crohn's disease. I was diagnosed when I was 16 years old. This blog is dedicated to providing motivation and inspiration for fight against IBD.

feeds.title: Leona's Life
feeds.description: Welcome to my life.I have been a Crohn's Warrior for 16 years, an ostomate for 7 years and for the past 6 years I have been battling with dysphagia. I am more then a chronic illness though,  I am a cat owner, equestrian, girly girl, tomboy, nerd.

feeds.title: The basement
feeds.description: Karen, Scottish (Highlander) 34. I suffer from Crohn's Disease and Dyslexia.

feeds.title: A Balanced Belly Blog
feeds.description: A Balanced Belly is your one-stop guide to living with gut health issues. If you're living with Crohn's Disease, Ulcerative Colitis or Coeliac Disease, you'll love the guides to the condition; along with plenty of easy to digest gluten and dairy-free recipes.

feeds.title: The Fault In Our Guts
feeds.description: I'm Eileen, 21years old. Living life as best I can. I love animal hats, the internet, my 3DS, books, cats, Disney World, laughter, pasta, fluffy things, the night sky, and dreams. I have Crohn's; Crohn's doesn't have me.

feeds.title: CrohnsDisease.com
feeds.description: Crohn's disease patient resources including symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, community, expert answers, daily articles. At CrohnsDisease.com we empower people affected by irritable bowel disease (IBD) to take control of their health by providing a community platform to learn, share, and connect with peers and healthcare professionals.

feeds.title: crohnsbae
feeds.description: I'm Ashleigh, 27years old. Originally diagnosed with Ulcerative Colitis and then Crohn's Disease after surgery in 2011. Writer. INTJ. Bookworm. English major. Avid coffee enthusiast, even if it's my sworn enemy. Obssesed with musicals and podcasts.

feeds.title: Living Crohns
feeds.description: I'm 21 years old, have Crohn's disease, just had my son (Oct. 2016), am married and work as a medication aide. I also have two cats and a puppy (boxer lab mix).

feeds.title: A SUPERHERO WITH CROHN'S DISEASE
feeds.description: ake a difference. Creator of 'Thoughts From The Crohner'.

feeds.title: Live. Laugh. Colon.
feeds.description: I'm a mid-twenty woman living with Crohn's disease & Arthritis. Trying to make the best out of every shitty situation. Remember: Laughter is the best medicine! Wanna learn more about IBD? Visit my blog.

feeds.title: Crohn's Happens
feeds.description: Hello there! Diagnosed with Crohn's disease in March 2016 and struggling ever since. Feel freee to have a look around and ask questions, and I'll answer in gory, disgusting detail.
